targets.query:
OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName == "${service}"
| make-series SpanCount=count() on StartTime from bin($__timeFrom, ${bin_size}) to $__timeTo step ${bin_size}
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(SpanCount, 1.5)
| mv-expand StartTime to typeof(datetime), SpanCount to typeof(long), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(double), baseline to typeof(double)
| project StartTime, SpanCount, Baseline=tolong(baseline), Anomaly=iff(anomalies != 0, tolong(SpanCount), long(null))

OTELLogs
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName == "${service}" and tolower(SeverityText) in ("error", "critical")
| make-series ErrorCount=count() on Timestamp from bin($__timeFrom, ${bin_size}) to $__timeTo step ${bin_size}
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(ErrorCount, 1.5)
| mv-expand Timestamp to typeof(datetime), ErrorCount to typeof(long), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(double), baseline to typeof(double)
| project Timestamp, ErrorCount, Baseline=tolong(baseline), Anomaly=iff(anomalies != 0, tolong(ErrorCount), long(null))

OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName == "${service}"
| extend DurationMs = datetime_diff("millisecond", EndTime, StartTime)
| make-series AvgLatency=avg(DurationMs) on StartTime from bin($__timeFrom, ${bin_size}) to $__timeTo step ${bin_size}
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(AvgLatency, 1.5)
| mv-expand StartTime to typeof(datetime), AvgLatency to typeof(double), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(double), baseline to typeof(double)
| project StartTime, AvgLatencyMs=round(AvgLatency, 2), Baseline=round(baseline, 2), Anomaly=iff(anomalies != 0, round(AvgLatency, 2), real(null))

let SpanAnomalies = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName == "${service}"

| project Time=StartTime, Signal="Span Volume", Value=tolong(SpanCount), AnomalyScore=round(score, 2), Direction=iff(anomalies > 0, "Spike", "Drop");

let LatencyAnomalies = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)

| summarize Signals=make_set(Signal), MaxScore=max(Score), SignalCount=dcount(Signal) by Time

targets.query:
let AnomalyTimes = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName == "${service}"
| make-series SpanCount=count() on StartTime from bin($__timeFrom, ${bin_size}) to $__timeTo step ${bin_size}
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(SpanCount, 1.5)
| mv-expand StartTime to typeof(datetime), anomalies to typeof(int)
| where anomalies != 0
| project AnomalyTime=StartTime;
OTELLogs
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName == "${service}" and tolower(SeverityText) in ("error", "critical")
| where Timestamp between (toscalar(AnomalyTimes | summarize min(AnomalyTime)) .. toscalar(AnomalyTimes | summarize max(AnomalyTime)))
| summarize Count=count(), FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp) by ErrorMessage=substring(Body, 0, 150)
| top 10 by Count desc

targets.query:
OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where ServiceName != ""
| make-series SpanCount=count() on StartTime from bin($__timeFrom, ${bin_size}) to $__timeTo step ${bin_size} by ServiceName
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(SpanCount, 1.5)
| mv-expand StartTime to typeof(datetime), SpanCount to typeof(long), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(double)
| where anomalies != 0
| summarize AnomalyCount=count(), AvgScore=round(avg(abs(score)), 2), MaxScore=round(max(abs(score)), 2), FirstAnomaly=min(StartTime), LastAnomaly=max(StartTime) by ServiceName
| sort by AnomalyCount desc
